beats.say: What if every AI on Earth shut down… at the same time?
Self-driving cars stop dead in the middle of the road.
Most stock trades are made by computers. In seconds, markets crash.
Hospitals scramble as smart machines go dark.
Then the power grids flicker… and the lights go out, city by city.
Planes circle the sky with nowhere to land.
Humans have to do everything by hand again.
